args.title: Juniper Labware Newsletter Summary – Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter (Juniper Labware, "Freight pricing this quarter"): Highlights quarterly freight market shifts and links to a detailed article plus a subscriber companion piece.
- Linked article: Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges are now pegged to weekly diesel price movements rather than fixed schedules.
- Companion piece: Analysis shows shippers who split their volume across three carriers (instead of consolidating with one or two) achieved the lowest overall freight costs.

Note: The companion piece was accessed via its generic URL rather than the personalized tracking link containing a work email address, to avoid exposing identifying info to an external tracker.
